description: This file is a shell script used for managing the Git web interface server such as starting, stopping, and configuring the web server (e.g., Apache, lighttpd, WEBrick, etc.) for Git web browsing among various server options. It includes configuration functions for different server types and handles launching the service with appropriate settings.

methods.name: resolve_full_httpd
methods.description: Resolves the full path and executable command for the specified HTTP server, adjusting the command with '-f' if necessary, based on the server type (e.g., apache2, lighttpd, plackup, webrick, python).

methods.name: start_httpd
methods.description: Starts the web server based on the configuration, including generating configuration files, handling PID files, and launching the server process.

methods.name: stop_httpd
methods.description: Stops the web server by reading and killing the process ID stored in the PID file.

methods.name: httpd_is_ready
methods.description: Waits for the HTTP server to be ready by polling the specified port until the server responds.

methods.name: lighttpd_conf
methods.description: Generates configuration file for lighttpd server.

methods.name: apache2_conf
methods.description: Generates configuration file for Apache2 server, including modules and CGI setup.

methods.name: mongoose_conf
methods.description: Generates configuration file for Mongoose web server.

methods.name: plackup_conf
methods.description: Generates a standalone PSGI server script using Plack, embedding configuration within the script.

methods.name: python_conf
methods.description: Generates a Python script to run a simple HTTP server with CGI support for gitweb.

methods.name: gitweb_conf
methods.description: Creates a configuration file for gitweb in Perl.

methods.name: configure_httpd
methods.description: Calls the appropriate configuration function based on the selected server type.
